name: Noctra
summary: A dark headphone launch page with four scroll-played scenes, a live countdown and a waitlist
about: A black, neon-lit one-page launch site for a pair of headphones. Four sticky canvas scenes play as you scroll: the headphones emerge from the dark under a sweeping rim light, a noise wave meets its mirror and flattens to silence, a battery charges to sixty hours and a turntable spins through three colourways. It ends with counting spec tiles, a ticking launch countdown and a waitlist form that validates and hands out a holographic pass.
how: The title decodes from random glyphs, a scan line sweeps the screen and the countdown chips rise in
Scroll the first scene: a rim of light sweeps across the headphones until they are fully lit and the light rings glow
Scroll the silence scene to push the anti-noise across; flip the cancelling switch to hear the difference in the dB readout
Keep scrolling to charge the battery to 60 hours, then spin the turntable or tap Void, Ion or Glacier to jump to a colourway
Spec numbers count up as they appear, and the countdown ticks to 12 December 2026 (add ?countdown=10 to preview the launch state)
Enter an email and pick a colourway to join the waitlist; a tilting holographic pass shows your spot, and you can start again
